Ana: Quick a11y smoke on the Usage Insights dashboard (dark theme). Noticed KPI pill text and tooltip triggers have low contrast and the compact KPIs lose focus outline when tabbing. Screenshot: https://redwood.app/s/figma/ghi789
Toby: Repro on Chrome macOS. KPI pill is 11px on dark bg; contrast ~3:1. Also keyboard order jumps past the KPI pills into the filter bar.
Harpreet: Chart tooltips are only mouse hover activated. Screen reader users don't hear tooltip context when focusing a data point. We should surface the tooltip text via aria-describedby on focusable points.
a11y-bot: Auto-scan (1776400012): failures: color-contrast (kpi-pill 3.05:1), focus-visible (kpi button no visible focus), aria (data point tooltips lack aria-describedby), skip-link missing.
Ana: Small fixes: bump KPI text to 13px + #eaf8ff on dark; make KPI pills focusable buttons with :focus-visible outline, and add aria-describedby linking to tooltip content. Also add a skip link to jump to main content.
Toby: CSS idea:```css
.kpi-pill { font-size:13px; color:#eaf8ff }
.kpi-pill:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #0b84ff; outline-offset:2px }
```
Harpreet: For tooltips, use <button aria-describedby="tooltip-<id>"> and ensure tooltip element has role="tooltip" and is in DOM. For chart points that can't be buttons, provide an offscreen list of data values that SRs can read when the chart receives focus.
Ana: I'll open RDW-8321 for the fixes (contrast + focus + tooltip ARIA + skip-link). Assigning to @Toby. Can someone run a quick VoiceOver + NVDA smoke after PR? 5-8 mins.
Toby: I'll deploy to staging and ping. Also adding a note to design checklist: "KPIs & small UI: validate 4.5:1 and keyboard focus."
a11y-bot: Reminder scheduled: full screen-reader audit next Tuesday 15:00 UTC.
Ana: Cool, marking RDW-8321 as blocking the Usage Insights release until verified.
